name: BytePlus Cloud Sandbox
description: VeFaaS cloud sandbox backend for OpenClaw agents. Commands run via Volcengine API Gateway HTTP endpoint — no SSH or VPC configuration needed.

sandboxId.description: VeFaaS sandbox instance ID (faasInstanceName). Omit to auto-create using functionId + credentials.

workdir.description: Working directory inside the sandbox. Default: /home/gem

token.description: Optional Bearer token for API Gateway authentication.

functionId.description: VeFaaS function ID for auto-creating sandbox instances.

timeoutMin.description: Sandbox instance timeout in minutes. Default: 60.

region.description: Volcengine region for VeFaaS API. Default: cn-beijing.

providerAuthEnvVars.name: BYTEPLUS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
providerAuthEnvVars.label: BytePlus Access Key ID
providerAuthEnvVars.description: Volcengine Access Key ID (for auto-create). Also accepts VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

providerAuthEnvVars.name: BYTEPLUS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
providerAuthEnvVars.label: BytePlus Secret Access Key
providerAuthEnvVars.description: Volcengine Secret Access Key (for auto-create). Also accepts VOLCENGINE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
